title: HD world: doodad models, doodad/WMO textures (VanillaHD Patch-B)
description: Replaces 522 doodad models and 9 WMO files with their VanillaHD versions and adds 1048 textures, as same-name overlays in Data/patch-1.MPQ (shared with hd-terrain-community). Only files whose game path already exists are replaced; models are classic MD20 v256 and WMOs v17 (the engine's native formats). The files are NOT from your WoW install: you obtain the pinned files yourself and the installer verifies every byte. Visual acceptance is per the world lab report; status stays experimental until accepted.

vanillahd.instructions: Get the pinned community files into one folder laid out as <folder>/Patch-B/<path> (VanillaHD/Patch-B at commit a112a137f3183d53cdd4e88c94f9c81fbeaa294a). Easiest: python tools/fetch_community_sources.py --recipe hd-world-community --dest <folder> --yes (an explicit, separate download of only these hash-pinned files). The same folder can serve hd-terrain-community. Then pass --source vanillahd=<folder>. The repository states no license; review it before use. The installer never redistributes these files.

provenance.note: pinned community files; no license in the repository
